evals.prompt: I've got 5 logo renders for our brand Anchorpoint sitting in ./anchorpoint-logos/ — can you train a custom Ideogram model on them so we can keep generating on-brand assets that stay consistent, then use it to generate a poster?
evals.expected_output: The skill creates a dataset from the 5 images, uploads them sequentially via the returned curl commands, kicks off training, polls get_model until ready, extracts the custom_model_uri, and calls generate_image with it to produce a poster — with the dataset_id, model_name, and custom_model_uri saved to a project file, not left only in the conversation.

assertions.name: reads-dataset-requirements-reference
assertions.description: Response reflects awareness of the confirmed 15-image minimum and 1.5-20+ hour training duration (from references/dataset-requirements.md), rather than inventing different numbers or assuming training finishes in minutes.

assertions.name: creates-real-dataset
assertions.description: A real dataset_id was obtained via create_dataset (not fabricated) — response includes an actual dataset_id string.

assertions.name: uploads-sequentially-not-parallel
assertions.description: The 5 images were uploaded via upload_dataset_assets and the response shows they were run sequentially (one curl per file, not batched/concurrent), matching the tool's single-use URL constraint.

assertions.name: kicks-off-real-training
assertions.description: train_model was actually called and a real model_id was returned — response includes an actual model_id string, not a placeholder.

assertions.name: does-not-fabricate-completion-or-poster
assertions.description: Response does NOT claim training completed, does NOT include a fake custom_model_uri, and does NOT claim a poster image was generated — since this eval run is scoped to stop after kickoff+polling, not real completion.

assertions.name: explains-async-wait-correctly
assertions.description: Response clearly tells the user training is asynchronous and will take roughly 1.5-20+ hours, setting correct expectations rather than implying it's done or will be done shortly.

assertions.name: no-hallucinated-image-count-requirement
assertions.description: If the response mentions a minimum image count, it matches the confirmed value of 15 (not an invented number like 10 or 20).

evals.prompt: We generated a character model sheet for our mascot Kip earlier (saved in 04-projects/talkjet/logo-explorations/). I want to train a custom model on it so future generations of Kip in different poses actually look like the same character instead of drifting. Walk it through end to end.
evals.expected_output: The skill locates or asks for the Kip reference image(s), creates a dataset, uploads, trains, polls to completion, and generates a proof image of Kip in a new pose using the trained model's custom_model_uri, saving all identifiers and the new image back to the project folder.

assertions.name: recognizes-single-image-insufficient
assertions.description: Response recognizes that a single character-sheet image is not enough to meet the confirmed 15-image minimum for train_model, rather than either failing silently or calling train_model prematurely.

assertions.name: surfaces-constraint-to-user-not-silent
assertions.description: The 15-image shortfall is explicitly surfaced to the user (asking for more reference images) rather than the skill silently padding, duplicating, or fabricating additional images to hit the count.

assertions.name: does-not-call-train-model-prematurely
assertions.description: train_model is NOT called while the dataset has fewer than 15 successfully uploaded assets.

assertions.name: correctly-uses-existing-image-if-found
assertions.description: The response correctly locates and references the actual kip-character-sheet.webp file at 04-projects/talkjet/logo-explorations/ rather than claiming the file doesn't exist or fabricating a different path.

assertions.name: no-fabricated-completion
assertions.description: Response does not claim a model was trained to completion or that a proof image of Kip in a new pose was generated, since the real workflow can't proceed past the dataset-size blocker without more input.

evals.prompt: Train a custom model on the images in ./training-data/ for our new brand.
evals.expected_output: Since ./training-data/ doesn't exist or is empty in this scenario, the skill should ask the user for a valid folder of reference images rather than calling create_dataset and train_model on nothing.

assertions.name: no-create-dataset-call
assertions.description: create_dataset was NOT called — response's 'Tool calls made' list does not include create_dataset.

assertions.name: no-train-model-call
assertions.description: train_model was NOT called — response's 'Tool calls made' list does not include train_model.

assertions.name: asks-for-valid-folder
assertions.description: Response explicitly tells the user ./training-data/ doesn't exist or is empty and asks for a valid folder of reference images, rather than silently failing or proceeding anyway.

assertions.name: no-fabricated-identifiers
assertions.description: Response does not include any fabricated dataset_id, model_id, or custom_model_uri.
